Tired of waiting? Wait no longer! You can now enjoy the new episode of "Rangers Between Worlds." Many things will happen in this episode. While in the other world they search for a way to resolve the situation, led by Captain Mua, in Silma's world, the rangers are in trouble. One in particular will have to deal with a difficult situation. Will she manage to get out of it, or will she fall victim to the vampires? Find out in this episode!
